557:t_036:1.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You promised, $$宗介$$! Make sure you come back!」

557:t_037:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, return at once! Ignore the remaining enemies!」

557:t_037:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Hurry with recovering the ground troops and surrendered enemy soldiers, too!」

557:t_037:3.en:
$$宗介$$
($$レナード・テスタロッサ$$... With all that power, why could you only do things that way...?)

557:t_037:4.en:
$$宗介$$
(You could have found another way...)

557:t_037:5.en:
$$宗介$$
(This feels awful. Now that he's dead, I keep thinking of things I want to say...)

557:t_037:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「But right now...! I'm going after the Major!」

557:t_038:0.en:
$$アル$$
「Welcome back, Sergeant. I'm delighted to see your safe return.」

557:t_038:2.en:
$$アル$$
「I'm immobile and practically scrap. In terms of tactical effectiveness, it's an entirely reasonable decision.」

557:t_038:3.en:
$$アル$$
「Though I would very much like to object.」

557:t_038:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「You're a smart mouth right to the end.」

557:t_038:6.en:
$$アル$$
「They've already evacuated to the Pacific Ocean.」

557:t_038:9.en:
$$宗介$$
(I don't know whether he meant 'Go' or 'Live,' but I feel like I've heard it somewhere...)

557:t_038:10.en:
$$アル$$
「Aren't you going to escape, Sergeant?」

557:t_038:11.en:
$$宗介$$
「Where to? According to $$レナード$$, these $$第３新東京市$$ ruins will definitely be caught in the $$時空震動弾$$.」

557:t_038:12.en:
$$アル$$
「It's regrettable that you don't have $$ブーストアップ$$ like $n.」

557:t_038:13.en:
$$宗介$$
「$n... He... got $$千鳥$$ back safely, didn't he...?」

557:t_038:14.en:
$$宗介$$
「Well, fine... I'll be grateful I got to see her one last time.」

557:t_038:15.en:
$$アル$$
「I'll be grateful I got to pay that cheating bastard back for $$陣代高校$$, too.」

557:t_038:16.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$レナード$$'s $$ベリアル$$? You really held a grudge...」

557:t_038:19.en:
$$アル$$
「$$ＡＧ$$ has just transmitted some data.」

557:t_038:20.en:
$$宗介$$
「It's probably something about my death throes and $$Ｚチップ$$s.」

557:t_038:21.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm not in the mood, but let's take a look.」

557:t_039:4.en:
$$風間$$
「...Well, that's our project. $$兜$$ and the others said you're having a tough time, too, $$相良$$, so we're posting our messages online.」

557:t_039:5.en:
$$恭子$$
「$$カナ$$-chan, $$相良$$... As you can see, I'm doing fine, so don't worry at all about what happened that day.」

557:t_039:6.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「Well... uh, $$相良$$... Sorry I snapped when you came to school to apologize...」

557:t_039:7.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「I was shaken up then, too... Looking back... I started wondering if it was fair to blame everything on you...」

557:t_039:8.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「But... I also felt like you were keeping us at arm's length...」

557:t_039:9.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「I think you and $$アルト$$ and the others had your reasons... But that kind of thing hurts...」

557:t_039:10.en:
$$宗介$$
「...Thanks, $$ＡＧ$$... I got to see something good at the very end...」

557:t_039:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Don't give up, $$宗介$$! Activate the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$!」

557:t_039:12.en:
$$宗介$$
「I can't... $$レーバテイン$$'s $$ＴＡＲＯＳ$$ has already been destroyed.」

557:t_039:13.en:
$$アル$$
「I cannot trace the Sergeant's thought patterns to use the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$, either.」

557:t_039:15.en:
$$宗介$$
「Thank you. But I want to meet my end listening to everyone's voices from $$陣代高校$$.」

557:t_040:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「How much time do we have left?」

557:t_041:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「No... I... don't want... to die...」

557:t_041:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「No... No... I want to go home... To that school, with $$千鳥$$... and everyone...」

557:t_041:6.en:
$$アル$$
「Before I try something, there's one thing I'd like to ask.」

557:t_041:7.en:
$$アル$$
「Am I human? Or a machine?」

557:t_041:10.en:
$$宗介$$
「To decide... All humans... do that.」

557:t_041:13.en:
$$アル$$
「I'll try it on my own.」

557:t_043:0.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I have a proposal, $$ベック$$.」

557:t_043:1.en:
$$ベック$$
「Whatever you say, I'm not falling for your smooth talk.」

557:t_043:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Then I'll simply say it. Would you consider stopping this fight?」

557:t_043:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Your freewheeling rampages and mercenary work for $$ファイヤバグ$$ aside, this isn't like you.」

557:t_043:5.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Destroying the world is utterly unfitting for a petty villain and proper thug like you.」

557:t_043:6.en:
$$ベック$$
「You picking a fight with me!?」

557:t_043:7.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Interpret it however you like. But even I can't bear to watch an old acquaintance sink so low.」

kept_omissions: 557:t_041:1/2: Still / do-not-want-to-die shared sentence keeps row break.
uncertain: 557:t_038:9: Explicitly preserves go/live ambiguity by romanizing the recalled word in preceding row.
557:t_039:8: 水くさい is emotional distance, not secrecy alone.
557:t_043:5: Proper thug preserves Roger's ironic 正しき, in contrast with world-destroying ambition.
